checksums.name: slot0_checksum

checksums.description: Slot 1 byte-sum over magic+records; matches stored 0x03AC in baseline.
checksums.name: slot1_checksum

checksums.description: Slot 2 byte-sum over magic+records; matches stored 0x03AC in baseline.
checksums.name: slot2_checksum

fields.description: Slot 0 header magic 'hachiemon' (EEPROM 8-byte blocks 0-1, rev8 logical domain).
fields.evidence: FUN_08075934 reads 8-byte EEPROM blocks into RAM buffer; FUN_08075ac0 verifies a block via FUN_08075934 plus 4xshort compare. Baseline rev8-logical bytes 0x00-0x08 spell 'hachiemon'.
fields.name: slot0_magic

fields.description: Slot 0 interior record area between magic and checksum; all zero in live baseline so interior semantics are unknown and left undecoded.
fields.evidence: Delimited by verified slot0 magic (ends 0x09) and verified slot0 checksum (starts 0xA6); span is a whole number of FUN_08075934 8-byte EEPROM blocks (blocks 1-20 partial). Checksum at 0xA6 covers this span.
fields.name: slot0_records

fields.description: Slot 0 trailing checksum word; 940 (0x03AC) equals the byte-sum of slot bytes 0x00-0xA5 in baseline.
fields.evidence: Python cross-check: sum(baseline[0:166]) == 940 == u16 LE at 0xA6; identical relation holds for slots 1 and 2. Written back through FUN_080759e4 8-byte block writes.
fields.name: slot0_checksum

fields.description: Slot 1 header magic 'hachiemon' at the 168-byte slot stride (EEPROM blocks 21-22).
fields.evidence: Same FUN_08075934 block protocol; slot stride 168 = 21 blocks. Baseline rev8-logical bytes 0xA8-0xB0 spell 'hachiemon', repeating the slot 0 header exactly one stride later.
fields.name: slot1_magic

fields.description: Slot 1 interior record area; all zero in live baseline so interior semantics are unknown and left undecoded.
fields.evidence: FUN_08075934 reads this span as EEPROM blocks 22-41 and FUN_080759e4 writes it back; delimited by verified slot1 magic (ends 0xB1) and verified slot1 checksum (starts 0x14E) with the same 157-byte interior geometry as slot 0.
fields.name: slot1_records

fields.description: Slot 1 trailing checksum word; 940 (0x03AC) equals the byte-sum of slot bytes 0xA8-0x14D in baseline.
fields.evidence: Python cross-check: sum(baseline[168:334]) == 940 == u16 LE at 0x14E. Written back through FUN_080759e4 8-byte block writes.
fields.name: slot1_checksum

fields.description: Slot 2 header magic 'hachiemon' at twice the 168-byte slot stride (EEPROM blocks 42-43).
fields.evidence: Same FUN_08075934 block protocol. Baseline rev8-logical bytes 0x150-0x158 spell 'hachiemon', repeating the header exactly two strides after slot 0.
fields.name: slot2_magic

fields.description: Slot 2 interior record area; all zero in live baseline so interior semantics are unknown and left undecoded.
fields.evidence: FUN_08075934 reads this span as EEPROM blocks 43-62 and FUN_080759e4 writes it back; delimited by verified slot2 magic (ends 0x159) and verified slot2 checksum (starts 0x1F6) with the same 157-byte interior geometry as slots 0-1.
fields.name: slot2_records

fields.description: Slot 2 trailing checksum word; 940 (0x03AC) equals the byte-sum of slot bytes 0x150-0x1F5 in baseline.
fields.evidence: Python cross-check: sum(baseline[336:502]) == 940 == u16 LE at 0x1F6. Written back through FUN_080759e4 8-byte block writes.
fields.name: slot2_checksum
